plugins.name: solo-leveling-shadow-monarch
plugins.description: Solo Leveling - Shadow Monarch: three worlds (System, Monarch, Dungeon), a shadow-knight companion with a pose per state, and a shadow army that grows with real tool calls.

plugins.name: noragami
plugins.description: Noragami: three worlds (Shrine Night, Far Shore, Takamagahara) and four playable main characters (Yato, Hiyori, Yukine, Bishamon), each with a pose per session state, signature effects, and the others joining you when subagents start.

plugins.name: hunter-x-hunter
plugins.description: Hunter x Hunter: three worlds (Godspeed, Heavens Arena, Zoldyck Estate) and four playable main characters (Killua, Gon, Kurapika, Leorio), each with a pose per session state, signature effects, and the others joining you when subagents start.
